notes:
All four lists now. With legacy mode off the tool reads protel's in-house list every five seconds and takes the move window, the arrival report and the departure report in turn — open any of them in the course of your own work and it is taken as it goes past.

The arrival and departure reports go in through their own writer, which can only state what its own rows say. A report names thirty rooms out of two hundred, and the rest of the ledger reads a missing room as a guest who has left, so it never goes near that. Room 9000 is ignored.

ALERTS is on the home screen below AUDIT: it pulses red while something is unread, groups by date, and Resolve removes for good.
